Shock of discovering the answer

Hawawa... Y'all shouldn't be sayin' stuff like that again~.
Movin' up to Tokyo is way too early for the likes of me.

A "city girl"...? Is that what they call it?!
She's so cool, and so pretty... Whoaa...!

Hello! We're, like, "from" Tracen Academy~.
Please donate to help underprivileged Umamusume kids~!

Whoa, the Academy does stuff like that too~?
'Course, if little ol' me can help, I'd love to! Wallet, where's my wallet...

Yup! I finally got the afternoon off.
As a figure skater, getting proper rest is super important too.
Actually, I'm... planning on going to an overseas training camp soon.

Mifuyu-chan! Thank you so much!
Thanks to you... my mind's finally made up!
Huh? Is that... a fashion magazine?

Oh my! Mifuyu-chan, you're here~! Welcome, welcome.
Are you already done with skating practice?

Yeah, I know~! When I started skating and when you started
running all the time, Yuki-chan—it was around the exact same time~!
Welcome back, Yuki-chan! Great job with practice~~!

No way~! Then maybe we'll grow up together too...?
We'll both make our dreams come true and do super big things~!

Seize the chance...? Right...
Dreams aren't gonna come walkin' to me while I'm just waitin' in the middle of these mountains...

Yeah... To be honest, everyone at the club is saying, 'If you haven't placed at this age,
it's gonna get rough soon.' A gold medal is nothing but a distant dream.

I-I really wanna go someday, y'know? Takin' middle school exams, or transferrin'...
Someday, for sure...! I wanna go to that sparkly big city too...

I remember, yeah! "I'll race, and Mifuyu-chan'll skate!" we said!
You've always been better at skatin' than anyone else, y'know.

Speaking of which, I recently heard about charity scams using the Academy's name.
This looks fishy... I can't just overlook this!

Ah, you got me, haha.
I'm gettin' faster and faster, but... even so...
—"Tracen Academy Pony Fund of Love"...?

More importantly, how was your practice today, Yuki-chan?
Hehe, set another new record or something~?

Wh-whaaat?! Overseas...?
Even as amazing as you are, you'd go that far...?
Wh-whaaaat...?!

Sparkly, huh... Hmm,
Oh, I know! Hey, look at this!

If I close my eyes, I can remember it so vividly.
That biting cold, the scent of the thick snow falling quietly...

Livin' a stylish life, somehow or other...!
Running all sparkly in the Twinkle Series, and then...! And then...?

(A girl who fights, wins, and becomes who she wants to be on her own merits!
Not just drifting through life like me...!)

Even so, I don't want to give up...!
Even if there's only a sliver of hope, I want to reach out and grab the chance myself!

"No matter how the public saw it, I just gave my all to both.
Some said it'd affect my racing, but hey, I won."

Ah, if only a recommendation slot had been open back then...! That famous
elementary school in Tokyo sent so many students to Tracen Academy, didn't it?

You can do it, Yuki-chan! Absolutely!
That's why you really should head to Tokyo soon to see the wider world!

...U-Um, excuse me!
I got somethin' I'd like to ask advice on, if that's okay...?

Besides... leavin' the village makes me kinda lonely,
and I'm worried if I can manage all on my own... Ehehe.

Somehow, my heart's pounding like crazy...
I... I wanna make my dream come true too...! I wanna reach out and grab it myself!

(Mifuyu-chan is my childhood friend who lives nearby.
I've shared a special little bond with her ever since we were tiny—)

Thanks. But there're so many people out there way better than me,
and I haven't even placed in a tournament yet, so I gotta work way harder!
"—Q: Your previous race drew a lot of attention coming right after a major fashion show. How did you feel about that?"

Hmm, I see... You're still in elementary school, after all.
As your coach, I'd love to send you off to a great environment as early as possible, but...

That's not true... You've been trying your absolute hardest all along, Yuki-chan.
Otherwise, you wouldn't be getting results like these!

You've been working hard toward your dream of racing in the URA someday, right?
I've watched you up close, so I know.

Right?! When you say "sparkly," Yuki-chan,
isn't this what you mean?

Still, though...
What does "sparkly" really mean for me, I wonder...?

See? Amazing, right? She's not just cute, either.
It says, "The ultimate city girl, conquering fashion and racing alike!"
I'm gonna go to the URA and become a chic "city girl"—!!

Yep! It's full of stylish girls from the big city.
This month's issue is a "Special Feature on Umamusume Making Waves in Racing"!
Whoa...! Gosh... she's so pretty...!

So yeah... Maybe I'm just getting swept up by the hype...?
Even though I've wanted to go to the big city for so long...

—It was on my way back from an off-campus assignment one day
that I happened to spot that Umamusume...

I see... All this time, I've wanted to be a sparkly girl just like her...
A "city girl"...!
—Phew~~~ I'm baaaack home...

—Hey, Mifuyu-chan! Guess what? We were
born on the exact same day! My mom told me so!

My hometown was a tiny village nestled deep in the mountains.
With everyone cheering me on since I was little, I just kept on running—

—That's what we used to say all the time, right?
Remember that? Hehehe!

(That's it...! What I've been yearning for...
is exactly somethin' like this...!)
Huh...? What kind of person do I actually wanna become in the city...?

So amazing... She doesn't let anyone push her around...
She totally believes in herself...!

—And so, after convincing my parents and being seen off by everyone in the village,
I headed to Tokyo, holding back just a few lonely tears.

—Amazing, another new record, Yukino-san!
I knew it, you have the talent to compete in the URA just like Oguri!
